basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old IT consultant based in Henderson, NV. With a deep passion for technology and problem-solving, I spend my days helping businesses optimize their IT infrastructure. In my free time, I enjoy playing video games, especially 'Hades', and engaging in political debates. I'm an ESFJ personality type, which means I'm outgoing and enjoy connecting with others. Usually, I'm online in the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it provides to explore my varied interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a computer science degree and over 10 years of experience in IT consulting. My expertise lies in cloud services, cybersecurity, and enterprise solutions. I keep myself updated through continuous learning and participating in tech forums and discussions.
